name: project-brain
description: Agent KBase — git native agent knowledge base (facts, stories, CLI, web wizard).

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @agentkbase/templates build && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/core build && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/cli build && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/mcp build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/web run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n core,cli,web "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/core run watch" "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/cli run watch" "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/web run dev"
scripts.dev:fast: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/web exec node scripts/copy-docs.mjs && pnpm --filter @agentkbase/web run dev
scripts.dev:resync: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n core,cli,web "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/core run watch" "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/cli run watch" "pnpm --filter @agentkbase/web run dev:resync"
scripts.brain:extract: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f apps/web/.env.local ] && . apps/web/.env.local; set +a; node ./packages/cli/dist/index.js extract-url "$@"' sh
